layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a thin red-bordered header band; a yellow circle with '50' sits at the top-right corner of the header. Below, the slide body is split into two side-by-side panels, each a scatter-style diagram with red axis arrows: left panel shows neighbor selection around a query point, right panel shows a sorted-distance voting chart. Each panel has a red caption centered beneath it.

regions.name: header band
regions.content: Title 'K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) , K=20' with 'K-Nearest Neighbors' in dark red and '(KNN) , K=20' in blue; yellow circle badge '50' at far right

regions.name: left diagram panel
regions.content: Scatter of colored circled points (green cluster lower-left, blue cluster upper-right, orange points bottom-center) with a red query point connected by thin lines to its 20 nearest neighbors, which are ringed with dashed magenta circles

regions.name: right diagram panel
regions.content: Ascending dot plot of 20 nearest neighbors sorted by distance; label 'K=20, green class' at top with 'green' highlighted in green; vertical blue cutoff line near the right; red dots along the x-axis baseline with dotted vertical lines up to each neighbor point

regions.name: captions
regions.content: Left: 'Select Nearest 20 Neighbors'; Right: 'Vote on 20 Nearest Neighbors', both in dark red

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates in large bold red/blue text; the two diagrams share equal visual weight; red captions are medium-weight; small black annotation 'K=20, green class' with green highlight is minor.

visual_elements.description: Left panel: 2D scatter with red L-shaped axes (no tick labels). A solid red query point near center-top. Thin gray/red lines radiate from the query point to 20 neighbor points. Neighbors are drawn as filled circles ringed by dashed magenta/purple circles: a green-filled cluster (~8 points) at lower-left, a blue/cyan-filled cluster (~9 points) at upper-right, and a few orange/tan points at bottom-center (some ringed, some not). One bright green point at far lower-left appears unringed.

Right panel: dot plot of the 20 nearest neighbors sorted left-to-right by increasing distance from the query point. Each neighbor is a small colored dot (cyan/green on the left rising through green to orange/tan on the right) with a thin dotted vertical line dropping to a red dot on the x-axis baseline (~20 red dots). A vertical blue line near the right side marks the K=20 cutoff boundary. Annotation at top: 'K=20, green class' with 'green' on a green highlight. Red L-shaped axes, no tick labels.
Yellow circle badge containing black number '50' (slide number)

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold, mixed colors (dark red for 'K-Nearest Neighbors', blue for '(KNN) , K=20'). Panel captions are bold dark red, smaller than title. In-chart annotation 'K=20, green class' is small black text with 'green' bolded on a green highlight. No bullet points.
animation_state: Fully built; no partial reveals apparent.
